origin.description: Replace latex macros with Unicode characters.
origin.details: A macro such as \' takes the next letter. Space before that letter is skipped. \aa has no argument.
origin.value: The tag list, with macros replaced by text.
origin.example:
x <- list(structure(paste0("\\", "'"), latex_tag="MACRO"), structure("e", latex_tag="TEXT"))
cat(deparseLatex(latexToUtf8(x)), "\n")

translation.description: Replace latex macros with Unicode characters.
translation.details: A macro such as \' takes the next letter. Space before that letter is skipped. \aa has no argument.
translation.value: The tag list, with macros replaced by text.
translation.example:
from tools.latex import deparse_latex, latex_to_utf8
nodes = [{"tag": "MACRO", "text": "\\'"}, {"tag": "TEXT", "text": "e"}]
print(deparse_latex(latex_to_utf8(nodes)))
